tools.name: estimate_break_cost
tools.description: Compute an itemised estimate of ending a lease early: notice-period rent, break fee, re-letting fee, rent until re-let, deposit credit and net cost vs staying. Use when the user asks what breaking their lease will cost. Do NOT use to weigh breaking vs subletting vs staying - use compare_options.

tools.name: compare_options
tools.description: Compare the net cost of breaking the lease vs subletting vs staying to term, ranked cheapest first with notes, risks and assumptions. Use when the user is deciding how to leave a lease. Do NOT use for the itemised break-cost breakdown alone - use estimate_break_cost.

tools.name: notice_letter
tools.description: Draft a formal early-termination notice letter (text only - nothing is sent) with property, lease date, notice period, move-out date, fee and deposit lines, plus a subject and delivery tips. Use once the user has decided to leave early. Do NOT use to estimate costs - use estimate_break_cost.

tools.name: negotiation_checklist
tools.description: Build a checklist and step order for negotiating an early lease exit with the landlord, tailored to the break fee, months remaining, mitigation duty and local re-let demand. Use when the user wants to negotiate the fee down or plan the conversation. Do NOT use to compute costs - use estimate_break_c
